## TideReader 1.0.0

First stable Windows x64 release. Existing settings, overlay profiles and SIP protocol version 1 remain supported.

### Playback and overlays

- Reads Windows media-session metadata for TIDAL desktop and supported browsers, with source selection and stale-session handling.
- Publishes text/JSON/artwork outputs and an OBS browser overlay with saved styling profiles and Smart Text overflow modes.
- Keeps richer TIDAL artist credits when available and validates settings/overlay listener startup before saving.

### Integration and troubleshooting

- Supports hidden service mode and LivePanel control through localhost SIP.
- Adds request/session/operation correlation, safe error codes and confirmed settings revisions.
- Separates actual overlay readiness from producer-observed source/browser freshness without exposing track titles, browsing content or raw failures in diagnostics.
- Recent safe operations are kept in memory (256 entries/14 days) and reset on restart.

### Installation

- `TideReader-1.0.0-win-x64-Setup.exe` and `TideReader-1.0.0-win-x64.zip`.
- Default package requires .NET 10 Desktop Runtime and WebView2. Existing installations upgrade in place; keep your configuration and output folders when upgrading.
- Authenticode signing is applied only when the release signing secrets are configured. Unsigned packages may prompt Windows approval.

- Fixes Windows SIP smoke collection resolution when Newman runs from a temporary working directory.

### Validation

See `RELEASE_VALIDATION.md` for automated test/build/security evidence and the limits of automated hardware/browser validation.
